title: Calm live phase gate refusal — root cause

answers.root_cause: the bar feed returned no bars; the gate was handed a frame with no session in it
answers.fix_class_note: PROVIDER_LAG for the refusal — external, operator action, no code change. EVIDENCE_BUG for the record, fixed here.
answers.code_changed: the evidence path only — provider, joined frame, observation row

the_morning.why_final_ts_is_yesterday_1344: the parquet's own 13:45 ET append boundary — the frozen half with no live half on top

the_outage.yesterday_same_instruments: fetched normally (MES 2340 at the Calm slot, MNQ through the Stress window)

the_probe.message: Historical Market Data Service error message: Trading TWS session is connected from a different IP address

the_evidence_defect.shape: returns pd.DataFrame() both on `if not bars` and inside `except Exception`
the_evidence_defect.consequence: a refused request and a quiet market arrive identical; the difference is gone before anything can record it
the_evidence_defect.family: an empty answer standing in for an error — same shape as the scheduler process scan returning [] for both 'none running' and 'could not look'
the_evidence_defect.why_fixed_at_the_provider: ib_insync does not raise on 162; it emits on an event and returns an empty list. The event fires before either return, and it is the only place the difference still exists.

hops: IBKRBarProvider.fetch_session_bars listens on errorEvent during the request and keeps named historical-service refusals in last_error
JoinedFrame.provider_error carries it, and as_dict carries it out
the data observation row emits it, or None when the feed genuinely said nothing
fail_soft_when: errorEvent will not take a handler

reproduced.why_2d_matters: the frozen parquet stops at yesterday 13:44, so yesterday's 13:45-16:00 close arrives on the same live fetch — a stub offering only today leaves partial_coverage standing and would 'find' a requirement bug that is really the stub's shape

verified: every fetch from 03:05 ET returned zero rows
the recorded gate codes, and their offline reproduction
the probe on client id 95 received error 162 and zero rows on all three instruments
inferred: that error 162 was the answer to the 09:32 and 10:02 fetches specifically — the probe ran later, and those rows cannot say, BECAUSE THE FIELD DID NOT EXIST. Strong (one continuous outage, one boundary, one named cause at the same gateway) and exactly the inference nobody should have to make. From the next fetch onward the row says it outright.

steps: log out the other TWS or IB Gateway session holding this account — only one may hold it, and paper and live are the same login
confirm with a read-only fetch; a slot's own row now carries the reason if it is still refused
until the feed answers, every Track 1 slot refuses — correct behaviour, the day classifies incomplete and does not count
operator_action.why_keep_it: the refusals are the record of a day the feed was down

defects_the_tests_found_in_my_own_work: as_dict did not carry the new field — a field added to a dataclass and shown to nobody

the mutation harness silently SKIPPED three mutations: these files are CRLF, so any anchor with a bare newline matched nothing, and a skipped mutation reads as 'we tried' while proving as much as not running it
hasattr only swallows AttributeError, so a property raising anything else took the whole fetch down — the attach is now guarded outright
